sentences: SAT asks whether a Boolean formula admits a satisfying assignment.
The source calls for unconditional superlinear time lower bounds in robust general computation models and ultimately stronger exponential bounds.
Many known barriers depend on unproved hypotheses or restrictions on memory and algorithm structure.
An unrestricted lower bound would directly demonstrate that a concrete fundamental problem requires more than near-input-reading work.
The saved note intentionally states a research direction rather than one fixed exponent, so a finished card must select the encoding, machine model, and quantitative threshold it intends to resolve.
